searchText: hmm, there seems to be a problem with prysm nodes on devnet-8 right now. the obvious one is, that prysm-geth-1 & prysm-nethermind-1 are not following the chain right now 😉 apart from that I've also noticed that prysm does not process sync committee duties for the slot after a block with blobs arrived. eg.: https://beaconlight-devnet8.pk910.de/epoch/4381 slot 140206 - 3 blobs, 100% sync contribution slot 140207 - 0 blobs, 80% sync contribution (all prysm nodes missing) looks like prysm needs too much time to process blocks with blobs? <@363800010518822915> the blobs from 136257 are included in the follow up block 136258. ah interesting, thanks for the tips ```time="2023-09-05 07:00:15" level=warning msg="Failed to save blob sidecar" error="nil or empty blob sidecars" prefix=initial-sync``` We are now outside the blob expiry window, so its possible that prysm is trying to fetch blobs that have expired. We have got one archive node on the network, and probably these nodes are not connected to it. I can try to manually add the enr of the archive node to all the prysm nodes, and see if it will sync back up. ah it looks like hte issue persists for all prysm (execpt prysm-besu) pairs. Hi folks, what's the latest estimated timing for Decun? 🔜 Does the tx-fuzzer do 4788 transactions? <@360491619402776577> Yes Wait no It does do 4844 transactions, I'll add a fuzzer for 4788 awesome thanks

excerpts.author: pk910
excerpts.content:
hmm,  there seems to be a problem with prysm nodes on devnet-8 right now.
the obvious one  is, that prysm-geth-1 & prysm-nethermind-1 are not following the chain right now 😉

apart from that I've also noticed that prysm does not process sync committee duties for the slot after a block with blobs arrived.
eg.: https://beaconlight-devnet8.pk910.de/epoch/4381
slot 140206 - 3 blobs, 100% sync contribution
slot 140207 - 0 blobs, 80% sync contribution (all prysm nodes missing)

looks like prysm needs too much time to process blocks with blobs?

excerpts.author: pk910
excerpts.content: <@363800010518822915> the blobs from 136257 are included in the follow up block 136258.

excerpts.content: ah interesting, thanks for the tips

excerpts.author: barnabasbusa
excerpts.content:
```time="2023-09-05 07:00:15" level=warning msg="Failed to save blob sidecar" error="nil or empty blob sidecars" prefix=initial-sync```
We are now outside the blob expiry window, so its possible that prysm is trying to fetch blobs that have expired. We have got one archive node on the network, and probably these nodes are not connected to it. I can try to manually add the enr of the archive node to all the prysm nodes, and see if it will sync back up.

excerpts.author: barnabasbusa
excerpts.content: ah it looks like hte issue persists for all prysm (execpt prysm-besu) pairs.
